song.title: since before YouTube
song.description: “It ain’t brand new—it’s just new to you.” The final recording of since before YouTube, with the full lyrics and a release note from the McDonald’s drive-through.
aliases: Tell Me Something That I Don’t Know

lyrics.text:
[Hook] Oh, tell me something that I don’t know ’Cause I was doing this since before YouTube You just found a sound I never let go It ain’t brand new—it’s just new to you
[Verse] Before “link in bio,” before “smash like” I was making weird shit in the middle of the night No tutorial, just “what’s this do?” Hit the wrong damn button—made something new
Now you’ve got a course and a point to prove Telling me the rules like I asked you to I’m still learning, but let’s be clear— You finding me now don’t mean I just got here
[Hook] Oh, tell me something that I don’t know ’Cause I was doing this since before YouTube You just found a sound I never let go It ain’t brand new—it’s just new to you
[Drop] Oh, tell me something Something I don’t know It ain’t new— It’s new to you
